scenarios.name: east-and-growth
scenarios.evidenceScope: Phone/tablet normal planner through all four maturities plus another UI section; every whole-problem credit checked. Full finite growth, stable items, observed life, districts, immutable production-rendered history, discovery replay and resumed learning.

scenarios.name: renderer-recovery
scenarios.evidenceScope: Actual WebGL context loss shows retry; an answer persists during fallback and another after Three recovery.

scenarios.name: onboarding
scenarios.evidenceScope: Actual profile-free Welcome, optional nickname in the grade screen, explicit preschool grade/math/range and first reserved section; no profile fixture injected. Dedicated production onboarding QA verifies play, storage boundaries, all subjects and retry.
